benefits.heading: All-in-One Compliance OS
benefits.text: Retire point solutions and run archiving, marketing, trading, and employee oversight on one AI-powered platform built for advisors.

benefits.heading: Marketing Review in Minutes
benefits.text: AI pre-checks content against SEC rules, so disclosures are right the first time and approvals fly through.

benefits.heading: Comprehensive Archiving
benefits.text: Every communication, action, comment, and approval is captured in a WORM-compliant archive you can export easily.

benefits.heading: Zero-Click Trade Monitoring
benefits.text: Continuous blotter surveillance flags front-running and best-execution gaps without adding back-office headcount.

benefits.heading: Seamless Broker Feeds
benefits.text: Connect brokerage accounts instantly via CFPB 1033 APIs and eliminate manual statement uploads.

benefits.heading: Future-Proof Architecture
benefits.text: Continuous platform updates keep you ahead of new SEC rules—no disruptive migrations ever again.
